title: C++ working draft: order and consistency of atomics
use: Language-level release/acquire synchronization. Live working draft; record a dated snapshot for a thesis. The bundled example targets C++17, not a claim to implement every feature in this live draft.

title: RISC-V unprivileged ISA: RVWMO, v20260120
use: A named hardware memory model for litmus reasoning. Use this version rather than a generic description of caches.

title: gem5 documentation: Ruby
use: Coherence and memory-system modeling. A route to richer protocol studies; not validation of the package’s atomic MSI model.

title: gem5 documentation: O3CPU
use: A detailed out-of-order CPU model. The package’s fixed-latency scheduler is intentionally much smaller.

title: MIT OpenCourseWare: 6.823 Computer System Architecture, Fall 2005
use: Historical architecture course notes for speculation, scheduling and precise state. Conceptual reading, not current product specifications.

title: Williams, Waterman and Patterson: Roofline report, UCB/EECS-2008-134
use: Original performance-model report. Helps distinguish an upper bound and bottleneck model from an end-to-end measurement.

title: Cornell ECE 5745: Complex Digital ASIC Design course portal
use: Starting point for an educational ASIC flow and course materials. Choose and record a specific offering; this link alone does not pin its tools or libraries.

title: OpenSTA documentation
use: Timing analysis, constraints and reporting. Pin a release or commit before relying on exact commands.

title: OpenROAD Flow Scripts: Flow Tutorial
use: Flow stages and example configuration. The bundled physical-flow entry points are learner-run inputs, not results.

title: OpenROAD Flow Scripts: Adding New Designs
use: Design integration and configuration. Check the version-specific environment, platform and paths.

title: YosysHQ SBY: formal extensions to Verilog
use: Assertions, assumptions, covers and past-state reasoning. Separate bounded checks from completed proofs.

title: YosysHQ SBY: configuration file reference
use: Tasks, proof modes, depth and engines. A solver or engine timeout must remain UNKNOWN/failed-to-complete, not PASS.

title: AMD UG949: Multi-Bit CDC
use: Vendor guidance for coherent multi-bit clock-domain transfers. The Python mailbox demonstrates a protocol, not analog metastability behavior.

title: AMD UG949: Optimizing for MTBF
use: Synchronizer reliability and implementation considerations. Do not infer an MTBF number from digital simulation.

title: Linux kernel documentation: EDAC
use: Error detection and correction interfaces and reporting. The 8-bit SECDED exercise is an educational code, not a model of a specific memory controller.

title: Linux kernel documentation: DMA API HOWTO
use: DMA address and mapping contracts. The local descriptor checker does not perform real DMA or configure an IOMMU.

title: Linux kernel documentation: thermal sysfs API
use: Thermal interfaces and policy concepts. Actual limits and protections are platform-specific and must not be bypassed.

title: NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook: paired observations
use: Why paired measurements require a paired analysis. The package’s bootstrap routine is an original teaching implementation, not a quoted NIST procedure.

title: Pro Git: Contributing to a Project
use: Patch preparation, review and contribution workflows. A local, reviewable integration can be educational evidence without guaranteed upstream acceptance.

title: CS2023: knowledge areas
use: A curriculum taxonomy for planning continued learning. Completing this package does not confer accreditation or a university degree.
